lesson_items_target_matches_kind.name: lesson_items_target_matches_kind
lesson_items_target_matches_kind.value:
case "lesson_items"."kind"
        when 'vocab' then "lesson_items"."lemma_id" is not null and "lesson_items"."concept_id" is null and "lesson_items"."passage_id" is null
        when 'grammar' then "lesson_items"."concept_id" is not null and "lesson_items"."lemma_id" is null and "lesson_items"."passage_id" is null
        when 'reading' then "lesson_items"."passage_id" is not null and "lesson_items"."lemma_id" is null and "lesson_items"."concept_id" is null
        when 'review' then "lesson_items"."lemma_id" is null and "lesson_items"."concept_id" is null and "lesson_items"."passage_id" is null
      end

lemmas_gloss_has_source.name: lemmas_gloss_has_source
lemmas_gloss_has_source.value: "lemmas"."gloss" is null or "lemmas"."gloss_source_id" is not null
